protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CLOSED: in 2.99.0 the default outbound validators check only HTTP header names and values, while HTTPRequestEncoder serializes request.uri and HTTPMethod.RAW verbatim and HTTPResponseEncoder serializes a custom status.reasonPhrase verbatim.
